title.ja: 同じ難しい初期値に対する線探索と信頼領域
title.en: Line search and trust regions from the same difficult starts

summary.ja: 同じ固定初期値からNewton・Armijo・doglegを比較し、真の根と非根停留・予算終了を区別します。
summary.en: Compare Newton, Armijo and dogleg from identical fixed starts, distinguishing roots from stationary nonroots and budget exhaustion.

assumptions.ja: 小さな固定入力・実数・無次元。詳しい入力と適用範囲は対応する契約に限定します。
assumptions.en: Small fixed real dimensionless inputs; assumptions and scope are limited to the matching contract.

algorithm.ja: 原残差とスケール付きmeritを分離し、Euclidean doglegと全試行ledgerを保存します。
algorithm.en: Separate the original residual from the scaled merit and retain Euclidean dogleg and trial ledgers.

validation.ja: 固定入力・独立参照・保存候補・全判定を同じ120秒予算内で検証します。数値合格と診断用非収束を区別します。
validation.en: Check fixed inputs, independent references, retained candidates and every gate within the same120-second budget. Numerical success and diagnostic nonconvergence are distinct.

limits.ja: 全初期値の成功や手法の普遍的優越、PETSc実装との一致を保証しません。
limits.en: No all-start guarantee, universal method ranking or equivalence to PETSc implementation.

caption.ja: 同一初期値の保存経路、原残差、trust radiusと実測評価回数。失敗・非収束は別記します。
caption.en: Saved paths from identical starts, original residuals, trust radii and measured evaluation counts. Failures and nonconvergence remain explicit.

references.author: PETSc developers
references.title: SNES: Nonlinear Solvers
references.review_scope: Read nonlinear solver categories, stopping/domain-error distinctions and selected line-search/trust-region descriptions. Our fixed Euclidean dogleg and Delta0=1 are independently specified; not asserted to reproduce PETSc defaults. Unread: MINPACK original report/paper, PETSc solver implementation source, Full manual outside named sections. Publication year not established (n.d.).
